title: Nostalgic Blackberry Crumble
description: A traditional dessert that combines the sweetness of blackberries with a crunchy oat topping.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together blackberries, brown sugar, and vanilla extract. Let it sit for about 15 minutes, until the blackberries start to release their juice.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, oats, and turbinado sugar.
Add the cold butter to the dry ingredients and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work the butter into the mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Transfer the blackberry mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish and top it with the crumb mixture.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream, if desired.
